messages:
sara.design: dropped a new compact-row variation for the latency dashboard. two options attached: (A) tiny funnel icon inline under the heatmap scrubber that opens a short overlay, (B) keep the toolbar minimal and surface sampling only in the kebab menu. which feels better for discoverability vs noise? :compass:

li.engineering: inline funnel wins for discovery. people look at the scrubber first. dev note: we only persist dashboard-level sampling today; per-chart requires prefs schema + migration. if we go inline, can prototype with local state and gate persistence behind feature:per_chart_sampling.

ben.pm: from user sessions, engineers expect per-chart quick actions. biggest confusion we saw: users thought sampling changed p95. microcopy must be explicit and short. suggestion: "Sampling reduces displayed points for performance. Metrics (p50/p95) stay full-accuracy unless you enable 'Lower metrics precision'."

mira.a11y: accessibility checks: funnel icon needs aria-label="Open sampling options for Heatmap" and visible focus ring. overlay must be role=dialog, trap focus, close on Escape and click-away, return focus to source. toggle should have aria-describedby pointing to the short help line. slider needs aria-valuemin="5" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow and an aria-live="polite" region for value updates. do not rely on color alone for on/off state — include text like "Sampling: On".

li.engineering: perf prototype: reading per-chart prefs adds ~22ms in render path. we can optimize later but flagging. slider will be step=5 and updates throttled with rAF to avoid repaint storms. will expose CSS variable --p95-badge-color to tweak contrast quickly.

sara.design: hybrid idea: keep the global sampling toggle in the toolbar for quick access, but add the inline funnel as a per-chart override that opens a tiny overlay with: On/Off, a 5-100 slider, breadcrumb "Applies to: Heatmap", and short help copy. default overlay closed. this keeps the toolbar stable and gives discoverability.

ben.pm: love hybrid. microcopy variants: long: "Sampling reduces chart point density to improve responsiveness. Aggregated metrics (p50/p95) continue to use full-data unless you enable 'Lower metrics precision'." short (compact): "Sampling reduces visual points; metrics stay full unless 'Lower metrics precision' is on." prefer short in compact UI.

mira.a11y: small copy tweak: make the toggle label exactly "Lower metrics precision" where used. add aria-describedby id on the toggle that points to the help snippet. ensure tap targets >=44px. color contrast: recommend p95 badge #a48ff8 on dark backgrounds or a 1px white outline if product wants the current purple.

li.engineering: telemetry plan: sampling.opened, sampling.toggled, sampling.rate_changed, sampling.scope (global|chart), sampling.help_clicked. gate per-chart persistence behind feature flag and roll out to canary orgs.

sara.design: i'll update the mock with the hybrid pattern, add the short help copy, breadcrumb, and accessible attributes. posting new mock: https://tiny.redwood/compact-hybrid-sampling. tagging notif-bot to create follow-up ticket. :white_check_mark:

notif-bot: created ticket #6123 "Hybrid compact funnel overlay for per-chart sampling + a11y checklist" assigned to li.engineering, due 2024-11-01.
